item.title: Verbose beta 324
item.description:
Steadier with long lists and TikTok sound

Mac

  • A TikTok slideshow link downloads its sound as an MP3 and transcribes it. Photo posts used to fail with Unsupported URL. Short links that lead to a photo post work too.
  • yt-dlp moves to October 26, which fixes a security flaw in older copies. Older copies could be fooled by a network that impersonates a website. The update closes that.
  • Each line of a transcript is built only when it's on screen, however long the transcript. Lines inside a folded sponsor read aren't built until you open it.
  • Recently Deleted, the Queue, Add from Library, and iPhone lists build rows as you scroll.
  • Empty, Restore all, and deleting many recordings change the library in one step. Before, each recording was handled one at a time against the whole library, which stalled large libraries.
  • Arrow keys in Search don't search again; the Cleaned tab measures text once per change.
  • It no longer rebuilds the whole transcript as playback moves, and shows find matches.

Release notes on GitHub
